title: the probe census reads a ticket whole and honours a forwarding order
intention: The probe-path census reads each ticket whole (plan and state merged through ticket_file), counts a WATCHME-standing ticket as it counts a PROVED one, and reads a probe a retirement deleted as forwarded, not missing, when a valid forwarding order in the corpus names its exact path.
why: Measured 2026-11-10 during 15d850266972: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py reds on {'tid': None, 'probe': 'cairn/tools/cairnmap/probes/the_roster_fault_is_one_finding.py'}. Since 284798998ab0 D11 a ticket is three files, and the census globs *.json, so it reads 7aed0fd0ba29's .state.json as a ticket of its own (no id). Over merged tickets (706 plans) two standing watches name a probe a retirement deleted: 7aed0fd0ba29 at PROVED (deleted by d547b4859f9a, 3882dac1) and 5a4ec289bf15 at WATCHME (cairn/machines/counting_block/probes/raise_rate_falls.py, deleted by 6935a4a71f93, f2b0d810). The WATCHME one is invisible to the teeth, which ask only PROVED and FIXME, though watchme_spec.stands_watch counts WATCHME as standing.
traces_to: Law 7 (a spec naming a missing file is a record that lies); ticket 693e9f45e6f2 (the census); the forwarding-order rule at cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py (_valid_orders).
how: census(tickets) builds the set of validly forwarded paths from the same ticket list (an entry whose from is absent, whose to exists and whose why is non-empty) and skips a probe whose exact path is in it. The proof's _corpus reads through ticket_file.plans and read_ticket. Tooth 1 asks PROVED and WATCHME. The two deleters' states gain an exact forwarding entry for each probe path, to bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py, through ticket_file.write_state.

clauses.claim: over the live corpus read through ticket_file, no ticket standing at PROVED or WATCHME names a probe that is neither on disk nor validly forwarded, and every census row carries its ticket id (none is None)
a FIXME ticket whose probe is absent and unforwarded names that path in its fixme list (the existing tooth, over the merged read)
a fixture PROVED ticket naming an absent probe reds the census, and a fixture WATCHME ticket naming one reds it too
the same fixture PROVED ticket does not red when another fixture ticket carries a forwarding order whose from is that exact probe path and whose to exists
an order whose to does not exist, or whose from still exists, or that names only the probe's parent folder, grants nothing: the fixture still reds

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/tools/base/watchme_spec.py add forwarded_paths(tickets, root) -> set[str]: for each ticket's 'forwarding' dict, an entry {from: {to, why}} counts when from and to are non-empty strings, why is a non-empty string, from does not exist under root and to does. Exact paths only — no prefix match, as build_inspector's charted-ref rule. census() in the proof skips a probe in that set.

D2: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py: _corpus reads through ticket_file.plans and read_ticket; census takes the forwarded set from forwarded_paths over the same list; tooth 1 asks cursor in (PROVED, WATCHME); new teeth for clauses 3 to 5; PROVES gains 1-5 under this ticket. The existing 693e9f45e6f2 'all' key stays.

D3: forwarding entries, through ticket_file.write_state: on d547b4859f9a, cairn/tools/cairnmap/probes/the_roster_fault_is_one_finding.py; on 6935a4a71f93, cairn/machines/counting_block/probes/raise_rate_falls.py; each to bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py with a why naming the deleting commit.

in: the forwarding field of d547b4859f9a's and 6935a4a71f93's state
out: build_inspector (its own forwarding readers stay as they are)
tickets at SUPERSEDED, RETIRED, KILLED, TICKETME or BUILDME

measured.saw: over 706 merged plans, 33 absent probes; at PROVED only 7aed0fd0ba29, at WATCHME only 5a4ec289bf15, none at FIXME
the deleting commits: 3882dac1 (d547b4859f9a) and f2b0d810 (6935a4a71f93); both tickets already forward their component folders to bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py, not the probe paths
measured.how: git log --diff-filter=D -1 per probe path; forwarding fields read through read_ticket
